briefing.headline: LGHL rockets 54.4% as small‑cap rally spikes
briefing.summary: Broad weakness hit the core mega‑cap tech and index tokens, with AMD down 9.2% and NVDA off 7.3% leading the sell‑off. Only a handful of stocks rose, highlighted by LGHL’s 54.4% surge and SNDQ’s 27.7% gain. The overall breadth was heavily skewed lower – 8 decliners vs 2 advancers among the core group – signaling risk‑off sentiment heading into the US open.
